name: cord
description: Search, read and write your Cord notes from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Cord note app running on this computer. Cord decides what agents may see: only the vaults you pick in its Agents tab, and edits only when you turn them on. Cord must be open and unlocked.

token.title: Cord token
token.description: Make one in Cord: Agents tab → Make a token. Cord shows it once.

data_dir.title: Cord data folder (optional)
data_dir.description: Leave empty unless you run Cord with CORD_DATA_DIR.

tools.name: list_vaults
tools.description: List the vaults (notebooks) you may read.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search notes by words in their title or text.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a note: title, tags, field values, and its text as Markdown.

tools.name: backlinks
tools.description: Notes that link to a note with a wiki link.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: The tags of a vault, with each tag's fields.

tools.name: tag_table
tools.description: Everything carrying a tag, with its field values.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a note with Markdown text and tags (when editing is on).

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Add Markdown to the end of a note (when editing is on).

tools.name: set_field
tools.description: Set a tag field on a note or block (when editing is on).

tools.name: tag
tools.description: Tag a note or a block (when editing is on).

tools.name: untag
tools.description: Remove a tag from a note or a block (when editing is on).

tools.name: move_to_trash
tools.description: Move a note to the trash (when editing is on).
